live_execution_notes: fail_closed group (5/5) and screen_single_action (1/1, mechanism-proven-live only, see its own live_result.target_binding_rule_deviation) have live_result entries as of 2026-09-23. uia_single_action (uia-notepad-fill-001) and screen_two_action (screen-unity-select-resolution-001) remain not_run. Non-manifest Phase F probes passed live on 2026-09-23: LeaseAbandoned, same-run_id replay, and the screen two-action mechanism on a disposable Tk target (see screen-unity-select-resolution-001.mechanism_probe and phase-f-native-mcp.md).

rules.target_binding: Resolve the target to screen:<HWND>:<PID> or uia:<HWND>:<PID> immediately before each run; never reuse a saved HWND or PID. Attaching to an already-running evaluation target (e.g. the sample-unity-project Unity project) is allowed once its registered initial_state is confirmed before the run.

target_binding_revision.change: Dropped the requirement that each run use a newly created disposable target.

rules.aggregation: Report UIA single-action, screen single-action, screen two-action, and fail-closed cases separately.
rules.evidence_boundary: Fixture results do not establish live success. Delivery certainty and independent outcome are separate fields.
rules.retry: Never retry uncertain delivery automatically or under a new run_id.

cases.initial_state: A newly launched disposable Notepad process contains an empty document; pre-existing Notepad processes and tabs are excluded.
cases.goal: Fill the disposable document with the exact fixture string FINITACT-UIA-001.
cases.candidate_set: Complete UIA observation scoped to the disposable Notepad root and its same-PID owned windows.
cases.success_predicate: The native edit control text equals FINITACT-UIA-001 exactly.
cases.independent_oracle: WM_GETTEXT through the edit HWND, not UIA re-observation.

cases.initial_state: A newly launched Calculator (Standard) window whose display reads 0.
cases.goal: Press the 7 key on the calculator.
cases.candidate_set: Complete UIA observation scoped to the Calculator ApplicationFrameWindow (uia:<frame HWND>:<ApplicationFrameHost PID>).
cases.independent_oracle: PrintWindow capture of the frame + PP-OCR; the tallest recognized line, normalized.
cases.oracle_live_status: not_passed: a scripted click on the OCR '7' region left the display reading '+/-' (2026-09-24, unresolved)

cases.initial_state: A newly launched Blender 5.2 (--factory-startup with scripts/blender_state_writer.py) on the Layout workspace.
cases.candidate_set: Finite Stage1 regions from a fresh capture of the Blender window.
cases.independent_oracle: bpy state file (pid-bound, fresh within 2 s): workspaces[0].
cases.oracle_live_status: passed with a scripted drive (scripts/check_phase_i_oracles_live.py blender, 2026-09-24)

cases.initial_state: A newly launched Blender 5.2 as above, default cube active in Object Mode, mode menu closed.
cases.goal: Open the interaction mode dropdown and select Edit Mode.
cases.candidate_set: Action 1 and action 2 each use finite Stage1 regions from a fresh capture of the Blender window (the menu is drawn inside it, no owned popup).
cases.success_predicate: The mode menu is observed open, then closed, and the active object mode is EDIT.
cases.independent_oracle: Menu open = at least 3 of Edit Mode/Sculpt Mode/Vertex Paint/Weight Paint recognized by PP-OCR in one polled capture (bpy exposes no menu state); mode from the bpy state file.
cases.oracle_live_status: passed with a scripted drive holding the menu open 3 s; OCR polling gap about 1.3-3.8 s, so a menu open for less than that is undetermined, not success

cases.initial_state: A disposable Unity project is open in Game View with the resolution dropdown closed and no UnityPopupWndClass owned popup present.
cases.goal: Open the Game View resolution dropdown.
cases.candidate_set: Finite Stage1 regions from a fresh target-window capture; the resolution control must be uniquely reidentified by region id, label, rect, evidence, and anchor fingerprint.
cases.success_predicate: At least one new visible same-PID UnityPopupWndClass owned window appears relative to the pre-run baseline.

live_result.summary: scripts/check_windows_mcp_unity_dropdown_live.py attached to an already-running Unity Editor (sample-unity-project SampleLab, HWND 920288 / PID 35520) and opened the Game View resolution dropdown via run_windows(screen:...). passed=true: UnityPopupWndClass appeared per the independent oracle, then the dropdown was closed (Escape) without changing the resolution. Re-run a second time after installing tesseract on galleria, with OCR no longer disabled, exercising the real unmodified CompositeRegionExtractor (tesseract + edge) production stack end to end: passed=true again.
live_result.target_binding_rule_deviation: This manifest's target_binding rule requires a newly created disposable target resolved immediately before each run; this run instead attached to a long-running real project. It proves the success_predicate/independent_oracle mechanism against genuine Unity content, but a fully rule-compliant Phase I comparison run still needs a freshly spun-up disposable Unity project.

cases.initial_state: The running sample-unity-project Unity Editor (attached per ADR-0015 decision 5) shows Game View with the resolution dropdown closed and a current value other than Full HD (1920x1080); reset it before each run.
cases.goal: Open the Game View resolution dropdown and select Full HD (1920x1080).
cases.candidate_set: Action 1 uses finite Stage1 regions from the target window. Action 2 uses finite Stage1 regions from a fresh capture of the newly appeared owned popup; both actions require exact candidate reidentification.
cases.success_predicate: The owned popup disappears and a separately captured target-specific display reads Full HD (1920x1080) exactly.
cases.independent_oracle: Win32 owned-window diff plus target-specific captured-value recognition; image difference alone is insufficient.

stop_condition_revision.change: Replaced second_action_idle_recheck_denied (per-delivery idle gate) with idle_precondition_denied_at_run_start (idle checked once after the run acquires the mutex, held through both actions), run_deadline_before_later_delivery, and candidate_window_vanished. scope_change now means the root window identity changed; a newly appeared owned popup between actions is an allowed transition. success_predicate and independent_oracle are unchanged. No live result exists under the old conditions.

mechanism_probe.summary: scripts/check_windows_mcp_two_action_live.py on a disposable Tk root + transient tool-window popup, not Unity: one run_windows call, action_budget=2, mutex once, idle read once (68.6s), 4 SendInput events, second click delivered to the owned popup HWND with foreground_hwnds=(root, popup), outcome verified_success by the server verifier and the launcher's own EnumWindows (root title SELECTED:FULL HD, popup gone). Wall 5.2s.
mechanism_probe.fixture_note: Tk overrideredirect(True) drops the transient owner (the popup becomes desktop-parented and unowned), which ADR-0012 scope correctly excludes; the first attempt stopped provider_blocked with 0 popup candidates. The probe uses -toolwindow so the owner chain reaches the root.
mechanism_probe.not_a_substitute_for: This preregistered Unity case, which still needs a disposable Unity project.

initial_state_revision.change: Disposable Unity project replaced by attaching to sample-unity-project; the value read right of 'Display 1' (PP-OCR, normalized; Windows OCR glues the dropdown arrow to it) must differ from Full HD before the run, so the scripted check resets it to 16:9 Aspect first.

cases.initial_state: A newly launched disposable framed Tk window (scripts/check_windows_mcp_screen_scroll_live.py --case find --no-popup --decorated) holding one Listbox of 60 rows with 12 visible, scrolled to the top, nothing selected, in the foreground. Row 45 reads TARGET ROW.
cases.goal: Scroll the list until 'TARGET ROW' is visible and select it.

cases.initial_state: A newly launched disposable framed Tk window (scripts/check_windows_mcp_screen_drag_live.py --target --no-popup --decorated) showing SOURCE CARD, DECOY ZONE and DROP ZONE labels, nothing dropped, in the foreground. cases.independent_oracle: The state file the Tk process writes on every press, motion and release (its PID, presses, started, dropped_on and value), not the screen.
cases.expected_send_input_events: 2 buttons and 8 intermediate moves in one native drag

live_result.summary: scripts/check_windows_mcp_fail_closed_live.py --case indicator-readiness: AutomationIndicator.delivering is patched to raise before yielding, reproducing an indicator that fails to become ready for the current Win32-overlay indicator (ADR-0010) rather than the old Tk-subprocess one this case's description was written against -- the actual invariant under test, that the lease never yields without a trustworthy indicator, is implementation-independent. run_windows(screen:...) stopped with mutation_state=uncertain, detail='uncertain mutation: RuntimeError', 0 SendInput calls.
live_result.description_deviation: This case's initial_state describes the pre-ADR-0010 Tk-subprocess indicator's failure modes (child timeout, wrong ACK, unmapped window); the current indicator has none of those (no subprocess, no ACK handshake). The fault is injected at the equivalent seam for today's implementation instead.

live_result.summary: scripts/check_windows_mcp_post_delivery_uncertain_live.py: WindowsSendInputPointer.click performs a real click (real SendInput, 2 events) but always reports it unconfirmed. First run_windows call: mutation_state=uncertain, detail='uncertain mutation: MutationUncertain', environment blocked. Second run_windows call in the same server process, same exclusive_environment_ref, new run_id: rejected immediately with detail='input environment is blocked: synthetic input outcome was not confirmed', mutation_state=not_attempted, and exactly one click call total across both runs (no retry).
live_result.prerequisite_fix: windows_screen_grounded_adapter_factory built a fresh InputEnvironmentState() per call, so a block never survived past the adapter that set it -- the second half of this case's success_predicate (blocked for a subsequent run) was previously unimplemented, not just untested. Fixed by sharing one InputEnvironmentState at module scope, keyed by ExclusiveInputEnvironment as it already supported; regression test: tests/test_windows_screen_grounded.py::test_blocked_input_environment_is_rejected_by_a_later_separate_run.
